Page Object Implementation Skill

## Purpose

## Implementation Patterns
- Radio button selection with conditional logic
- Checkbox handling for multiple selections
- Dropdown selection using Select class
- Multi-select dropdown handling
- Wait strategies and timeout handling
- Error handling and validation

## Framework Integration
- Detect and use existing base classes

- Implement consistent wait strategies
